Albus Dumbledore
Albus Dumbledore
Brilliant and often controversial 
headmaster of Hogwarts School of 
Witchcraft and Wizardry, Albus 
Dumbledore is most famous for is 1945 defeat of 
Grindelwald and his steadfast championing of 
Harry 
Harry Potter, the Boy Who Lived. 
Dumbledore’s self-proclaimed 
proudest achievement, however, 
was featuring 
on a Famous Wizards 
Chocolate Frog Card.
DIY-HarryPotter

Bertie Bott
Bertie Bott
He invented Bertie Bott’s Every-Flavour 
Beans quite by mistake. His original 
purpose was to create tasty sweets 
from food
from food. After an accident during his experiment, 
he recognized the sales potential of flavours that 
range from delicious to disgusting, 
including marshmallow, tutti-frutti, 
grass, soap and earwax.

DIY-HarryPotter
Filius Flitwick
Filius Flitwick
Head of Ravenclaw House and 
Charms teacher. A tiny little wizard who 
squeaks when he talks and has to stand 
on a pile of books to see over his desk
on a pile of books to see over his desk. Rumored to 
have been a dueling champion when he was young 
and to know a great deal 
about Entrancing Enchantments.

Gilderoy Lockhart
Gilderoy Lockhart
Wizarding celebrity author, Gilderoy 
Lockhart, wrote many books on his 
encounters with dark creatures 
and received many prestigious awards
and received many prestigious awards, including 
Order of Merlin, Third Class and Honorary Member 
of the Dark Force Defense League. 
After losing his memory in a series 
of unfortunate events he released 
his final book entitled 
Who Am I?

Godric Gryffindor
Godric Gryffindor
One of the four famous founders of 
Hogwarts School of Witchcraft 
and Wizardry, Godric Gryffindor was 
the most accomplished dueler of his time, an 
enlightened fighter against Muggle-discrimination 
enlightened fighter against Muggle-discrimination 
and the first owner of 
the celebrated Sorting Hat.
DIY-HarryPotter

Helga Hufflepuff
Helga Hufflepuff
One of the four famous founders of 
Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and 
Wizardry, Helga Hufflepuff was 
particularly famous for her dexterity at food-related 
Charms. Many recipes traditionally served at 
Hogwarts feast originated 
Hogwarts feast originated 
with Hufflepuff.
DIY-HarryPotter

Horace Slughorn
Horace Slughorn
Horace Slughorn is the new Potions 
teacher in Harry’s sixth year at 
Hogwarts. He possesses a crucial 
memory – one that Harry must access in order to 
learn the secret of finishing 
Lord
Lord Voldemort.
DIY-HarryPotter

Lord Voldemort
Lord Voldemort
Lord Voldemort was once a Hogwarts 
student named Tom Marvolo Riddle. 
A descendant of Salazar Slytherin and 
ashamed of his non-wizard father, he murdered Lily 
and James Potter when Harry was just a 
baby
baby – and gave Harry Potter his famous 
scar. It is said the only wizard Lord 
Voldemort has ever been frightened 
of is 
Albus Dumbledore.
DIY-HarryPotter

Minerva McGonagall

Minerva McGonagall
Strict and clever Transfiguration teacher 
and head of Gryffindor House. Rather 
severe-looking woman who sometimes 
wears square glasses exactly the shape of the 
markings of a cat. Her black hair is 
drawn into a tight bun
drawn into a tight bun. Warns students 
that anyone messing around in her 
class will leave and 
not come back.

Quirinus Quirrell
Quirinus Quirrell
Defense Against the 
Dark Arts professor during 
Harry’s first year at Hogwarts. His 
classroom always smelled like garlic. A pale, 
trembling young man with a twitching eye and the 
trembling young man with a twitching eye and the 
nervous stammer who always wore an 
absurd turban. Rumored to have 
met vampires and a hag in 
the Black Forest during 
a year off from 
Hogwarts and was 
never the same
never the same.

Rolanda Hooch
Rolanda Hooch
Flying professor at Hogwarts. Also 
referee for inter-house Quidditch 
matches. Athletic looking witch with 
short gray hair, piercing golden eyes and hawk-like 
profile. Used to be a Chaser for the 
English Quidditch team
English Quidditch team.
DIY-HarryPotter

Rowena Ravenclaw
Rowena Ravenclaw
One of the four famous founders of 
Hogwarts School of Witchcraft 
and Wizardry, Rowena Ravenclaw 
was the most brilliant witch of her time, though 
legend has it that a broken heart
 –
 – cause unknown- contributed to 
her early demise. Her daughter 
Helena (the Grey Lady) is the 
Ravenclaw house 
ghost at Hogwarts.
DIY-HarryPotter

Rubeus Hagrid
Rubeus Hagrid
the gamekeeper and Keeper of Keys 
and Grounds of Hogwarts. A Gryffindor
 when a student at Hogwarts, he is almost 
twice as tall as a normal man and at least five times as wide
twice as tall as a normal man and at least five times as wide. 
With long tangles of bushy black hair and a beard that hides 
most of his face, his hands are the size of 
trash can lids, and his feet, in their leather 
boots, are like baby dolphins. Albus 
Dumbledore has said 
that he would trust 
Hagrid with 
Hagrid with 
his life.

Salazar Slytherin
Salazar Slytherin
One of the four famous founders of 
Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and 
Wizardry, Salazar Slytherin was one of 
the first recorded Parselmouths, an accomplished 
Legilimens and a notorious champion of 
pureblood supremac
pureblood supremacy. His last remaining 
heir was Lord Voldemort.

Severus Snape
Severus Snape
Head of Slytherin House and potion 
teacher. He has greasy black hair, a 
hooked nose, sallow skin and black 
eyes. was at Hogwarts as a student when James 
Potter was there. Rumored to desire the 
position of Defense 
position of Defense Against the Dark 
Arts teacher at Hogwarts.
